sloka: रक्षितुं सुमहद्राज्यमहमेकस्तु नोत्सहे ।पौरजानपदांश्चापि रक्तान् रञ्जयितुं तथा ॥ २.११२.११॥
transliteration: rakṣituṁ sumahadrājyamahamekastu notsahe ।paurajānapadāṁścāpi raktān rañjayituṁ tathā ॥ 2.112.11॥

translations.english: I do not venture to protect this kingdom all by myself and keep the inhabitants of the towns and villages who are loyal to you pleased.
